summary: Show declaration-driven agent relaunch as restarting until the replacement harness is ready

replay.detail: No replay fallback, history reconstruction, read-triggered repair or recovery wait is added.

schema.detail: The claim registry adds optional runtime.observed restarting_from (retired incarnation). No SQLite table, index, trigger, schema version or migration changes. The registry and replication compatibility digests change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, canonical selection, membership, admission authority or launch decision rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Client agent state can be restarting during an existing declaration-driven shutdown and replacement-readiness interval. AgentState already permits arbitrary strings. First starts remain starting; current human blocks, faults, moves, suspension and terminal failures retain their existing presentation. Older receiver registries do not recognize the added observation field; upgrade fleet members together before relying on this status. Mixed-version runtime acceptance and older UI rendering have not been validated.

downtime.detail: No added stop, relaunch, daemon downtime or startup recovery is introduced. Candidate restart-to-API and restart-to-health times have not been measured.

manual.detail: No data or identity conversion is required. Consumers of the open agent-state string should display restarting during declaration cutover.

recovery.detail: Use matching receiver registries for observations containing the optional field. This change does not establish swap-back compatibility to a build whose registry lacks that field, or change existing launch failure recovery.
